intro: Kiva Coffee Table channels mid-century restraint with quiet functionality. Solid Sheesham wood, a tray-edged top, and an open storage shelf come together in a design that is modern and practical.

features.title: Wide tabletop for everyday gatherings
features.text: Kiva features a generously sized surface that accommodates everything from morning coffee to evening conversation. It is thoughtfully proportioned to maximise usable space without overwhelming the room.

features.title: Integrated storage shelf for organisation
features.text: Including a functional lower shelf, this table is designed for books, magazines, and everyday essentials. This integrated storage keeps living spaces organised while maintaining a clean, uncluttered visual profile.

features.title: Sturdy Sheesham wood frame
features.text: Made entirely from solid Sheesham wood, the table delivers dependable strength and structural stability. The sturdy build ensures confident support and reliable performance through regular, everyday use.

features.title: Warm, timeless wood aesthetic
features.text: The natural grain and rich tones of Sheesham wood bring warmth to your living space. Its classic finish ensures the table complements both contemporary and traditional interiors.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
